I can list them, but I need your exact definition of “within-cycle association.” Please confirm:
- Model: unadjusted (LBXTC ~ LBXPFOA) or adjusted (which covariates)?
- Scale: raw vs log-transformed (e.g., log2 PFOA)?
- Survey design: use NHANES weights/PSU/strata?
- Sample: adults ≥20 only? Fasting status?
- Cycles to include: all cycles where LBXPFOA is available?

If you’re okay with a default (survey-weighted, unadjusted linear regression of LBXTC on LBXPFOA among adults ≥20, complete cases, by cycle), say “use default,” and I’ll give the exact cycle letters/years with negative slopes.
